name: Relative abundance composition
description: Plot percentage-based taxonomic profiles such as MetaPhlAn CAMI output at one taxonomic rank. Uses supplied percentages without inventing read counts or renormalising away unreported abundance.

outputs.name: composition
outputs.description: Supplied taxon percentages at the selected rank; no estimated read counts.

outputs.name: composition_plot
outputs.description: Per-sample stacked percentages and an explicitly labelled remainder.

citation: SeqDesk percentage-preserving composition using pandas and Plotly. Cite the original profiler, database and source dataset separately.
